title: GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Learn how GPT-5.6 powers Microsoft 365 Copilot with stronger AI capabilities across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat, and Cowork for faster, higher-quality work.
body: Learn how GPT-5.6 powers Microsoft 365 Copilot with stronger AI capabilities across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat, and Cowork for faster, higher-quality work.
summaryZh: 本文报道了GPT-5.6正式成为Microsoft 365 Copilot的首选底层模型。该模型通过增强的AI能力深度赋能Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Chat和Cowork等办公组件，为用户在企业和日常办公场景中提供更快、更高质量的自动化协作与内容生成体验。

aiReview.reasonZh: GPT-5.6模型被选为Microsoft 365 Copilot的底层首选模型，标志着新一代大模型在主流办公场景的规模化落地。
